statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and transient neurological deficits
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as the underlying etiology of a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
CPT 93226 is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The service is ordered to evaluate for atrial fibrillation burden and other arrhythmic activity
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the procedure is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
